- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.0), model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is negative (≤ -0.1), model often underestimates; increase forecast modestly.
- Model frequently overshoots after recent price spikes; apply a 1–2 day lag correction downward.
- Mean reversion is strong in 30-day horizon; if forecast is > 2σ above recent mean, reduce by 5–10%.
- If sentiment history shows repeated negative swings, model tends to lag recovery; add 0.5–1.0 point buffer to forecast.
- For 30-day forecasts, avoid sharp upward moves unless sentiment is strongly bullish (> 0.3); otherwise, cap growth at 1–2% above prior 14-day average.
